title: D-2 retirement removal proofs

acceptance.workspaceTarget: plan() optional 5th param retired?: HarnessRetiredSources; planRemovals sets retiredItemId = skillsShRetiredItemId(basename(root)) for sources inside a retired root (isInsideRoot). apply routes retired removals to removeRetiredCopy: contained relative path, lstat with no links on every segment, kind + manifest hash match, git untracked proof, then delete through prepareOwnedOverwrite. Kept copies are disowned, never snapshot-removed.
acceptance.git: execFile('git', ['--literal-pathspecs','ls-files','--error-unmatch','--',relPath]), cwd = workspace root, 5000 ms timeout, no shell, LC_ALL=C, GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_INDEX_FILE removed. Only exit 1 + 'did not match any file(s) known to git' is untracked; exit 0 git-tracked; everything else unverifiable.
acceptance.mcp: planMcpFacet 5th param retiredServerKeys (default []) sets retiredItemId = mcpRetiredItemId(key). applyMcpFacet optional 6th param McpRetirementContext {baseEntries, probeGitTracking}. Retired key removed only if its entry hash equals the owned manifest hash (else kept edited); workspace config files get the git probe, home configs skip it; only that key is removed; I/O failure or missing context -> writeFailed with itemId (stays owned).

fixtureMatrix: Real git: untracked unchanged owned skill dir and command file deleted; git-added kept git-tracked; edited kept edited (no snapshot); non-repo (128) kept unverifiable. Stubbed ENOENT/timeout/other stderr/128 kept unverifiable. Blocked history dir -> writeFailed. Symlinked parent and ../escape kept unverifiable without git call. Absent copy -> removedRetired. Non-retired removal keeps snapshot path. MCP: home owned unchanged key removed with siblings and hand-added key intact; edited kept; workspace tracked/unverifiable kept; untracked removed; real git through WorkspaceHarnessTarget removes only the retired key; hand-added key never planned; I/O errors and missing context -> writeFailed.

verification.result: exit 1. 68 tasks: 65 succeeded, 3 failed. harness-sync:test 699/701 (only the 2 known agent-workspace-scope.spec.ts env failures); known ptah-extension-webview:lint; ptah-electron:test 2 git-watcher timing tests under machine load. Coordinator re-ran `npm run verify -- -t test -p ptah-electron -- --testPathPatterns=git-watcher` -> exit 0 (/tmp/tpd-b23-gitwatcher.log), so those 2 are load flakes, not this batch.

decisions: An already-absent retired copy is reported in removedRetired.
An invalid or escaping manifest path is kept unverifiable (disowned), not writeFailed, because a retry cannot succeed.
A kind mismatch is kept edited.
Workspace MCP config files also get the git probe on the config file path.
GitTrackingProbe type lives in the planner and its implementation (createGitTrackingProbe) in workspace-target.ts, to avoid a circular import.
risks: git ls-files on a directory returns 0 if any file under it is tracked, so a partly tracked skill is kept.
Output-buffer overflow on a large tracked dir is classified unverifiable (kept).
